content: Citation-grade retrieval conventions (multiple shipping tools, cross-verified): (1) search results carry stable id + path + line range: qmd docid #abc123 + path:from:count + get fromLine/maxLines/lineNumbers (since 2.5.3); flash-context default repo-relative path:42-88; Sciverse chunk_id/doc_id/offset + read_content(doc_id, offset); NeMo Retriever skill preserves document_id/source_id/page. (2) Two-stage discipline: Vault-Agent-Memory policy — read_range returns numbered lines + stable L5-L6 refs; final answers may cite ONLY read_range output, never search snippets; qmd skill: 'Output is line-numbered and carries the docid — cite both'. (3) Content hashes for drift/verification not identity: groundkit content-hash ingest + path+char-offset citations + verify_citation against source; apogee chunk id source#slug[#part]+sha256 stable across re-ingest; agentic-reports hash-match proves snapshot consistency not truth. (4) Structured output is the reliable citation mapping: Microsoft Foundry Q&A confirms inline citation markers have no official mapping to knowledge_base_retrieve chunk ids — rely on tool structured output. manicule: citations resolve to page/heading/line/cell, slug permanent identity.
